name: io.github.tonyyang0504/yoycol-mcp
description: Yoycol (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping. Every tool maps to a d

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YOYCOL_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: accessKey issued by Yoycol for OPEN API V4 (sent as X-API-Access-Key).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YOYCOL_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: secretKey issued with it; signs every request (Base64 HMAC-SHA256 over method, path, timestamp, nonce, accessKey, algorithm, version and the sorted query). Never sent on the wire.
